entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I've been wondering, is there a possibility[n]that we will find our own Shadows within[n]Mementos?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's not possible. Our Shadows are[n]always by our sides, remember?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Acknowledging, facing, and becoming[n]able to wield your own Shadow is what[n]makes you into a Persona-user.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's why we can't have Palaces. It's[n]also why our Shadows can't exist in[n]other people's Palaces.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, but we saw Panther's Shadow over[n]in Kamoshida's Palace.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, that thing was NOT mine!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That was just a cognition formed by[n]Kamoshida's mind. It was nothing like[n]Panther's actual Shadow.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So wielding a Persona involves[n]acknowledging one's Shadow...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Considering that fact, Joker's ability to[n]control multiple Personas is truly special.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Right? That just proves my judgment of[n]him was correct!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, you were real surprised too when[n]it happened...
